Thanks for the quick turnaround, Lena — that’s helpful.

Short answers up front:
- KV cache: yes, the run used prefix/KV caching for interactive flows.
- Quantization/precision: we used an int8-quantized runtime for the production-like runs and fp16 for validation runs. The attached test plan (redwood_test_plan_v1.yaml) details the exact kernel/config.
- The P95 numbers you asked for were measured with 8 concurrent streams at seq_len=1024; I’ll ask Karthik to paste the exact slate into the demo slides.

We’ll plan for Tue June 1 at 10:00 PT (18:00 CET) — please confirm that Tim and procurement can make that slot. I’ve looped in Ben from pricing so procurement has a single point of contact.

If confirmed, I’ll send calendar invite and a short agenda (30–45m): 5m intro, 20m technical readout (Karthik), 10m SLA/contract items (Marissa/Ben), 5–10m Q&A.

Marcus
